June 10, 2018 - By Darrin Black
William Leland Edwards decreased its stake in Ebay Inc (EBAY) by 96.25% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Palo Capital Inc sold 65,114 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.44% with the market. The hedge fund run by William Leland Edwards held 2,536 shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $102,000, down from 67,650 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Palo Capital Inc who had been investing in Ebay Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $40.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.40% or $0.16 during the last trading session, reaching $40.29. About 4.99 million shares traded. eBay Inc. (NASDAQ:EBAY) has risen 7.72% since June 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.85% the S&P500.
